newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman awards Motorola mobile phone contract.
newsitem.headline: Oman awards Motorola mobile phone contract.

text.p: Oman on Wednesday awarded a five million ($13.2 million) contract to Motorola Inc to expand the Global System for Mobile communications (GSM) network in two of its provinces.
Oman's Telecommunications Minister Ahmed bin Suwaidan al-Balushi signed the contract -- which should be implemented within six months -- with Motorola officials, the official Oman News Agency said.
Balushi said the number of mobile telephones in use since Oman launched the GSM network last October had risen to 42,000 and expected the number to rise to 50,000 by the end of 1997.
"Before the end of the year we will have lines and facilities for 100,000 users," he said.
Oman earlier this month awarded a $20 million contract to Sweden's L.M. Ericsson to expand the GSM network in the capital Muscat.
